title: Mara and the Horizon
author: Mara Oyelaran
blurb: Marguerite Coldharbour, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
